{"consolidated_memory":"**mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt - Data Loss Incidents (Two Occasions)**

Component: mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt (mobile sync side)
Test coverage: mobile/android/OfflineCacheTest.kt
Stack: Kotlin
Common repro: force stop the app with unsynced edits
Common symptom: local row missing after next launch

---

**OCCASION 1: [2026-06-03]** (c006-e1)
- Environment: staging read replica
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #5260 on branch fix/data-loss-2
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 58 days running

**OCCASION 2: [2026-06-16]** (c006-e2)
- Trigger: turned up after client had already retried once
- Root cause: listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR #6160 on branch fix/data-loss-3
- Result: job finished in 71 minutes instead of 7 hours"}
